cards.title: Borrowed Authority
cards.instruction: Project confident authority while quietly working to keep everyone cooperative. Your confidence depends on their cooperation.

cards.title: Outside the Scope
cards.instruction: Redirect personal or dangerous questions by declaring them irrelevant, premature, or assigned to another process.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I'd like to keep this voluntary. Whether I broke the window is outside this repair meeting's scope. Please.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Then let's hold a responsibility meeting.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I'm still in charge; we can make an adjustment. After the repairs. We need a safe venue.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Location changes require a separate planning discussion.

mechanism: A chairs window repairs, concedes practical meeting changes, and uses each change to postpone the question of personal responsibility.
confusable: Unlike denying the breakage, A refuses the question by assigning it to later discussions.
comparison: Venue relocation and chair carrying differ from a couple negotiating dessert cancellation.
seedUse: D182-a broken window and outside meeting; S02-a makes real setup concessions while controlling the agenda.
